hypothesis: Among the daily entries of the deterministic strategy (momentum_24h > 0 at the 00:00 UTC cutoff, LONG/FLAT spot), a logistic model on cutoff-only stationary features identifies entries whose 24h LONG round trip is not worth trading; filtering them raises the out-of-sample net return after costs without worsening the mark-to-market drawdown.

dataset.note: S02 BTCUSDT-1h-research-v1: latency 0h, horizon 24h, fee 0.1% and slippage 0.05% per side, stride 24h

target.definition: long_net_return_pct > 0 for a LONG opened at the cutoff open and closed at the open 24h later, CP07 costs on both sides (S02 execution contract)

baseline.description: LONG at a cutoff when momentum_24h > 0, FLAT otherwise; decisions only at S02 cutoffs, position held while the signal persists

model.train_population: baseline entries with targets mature before dev_start

threshold_selection.objective: sum of long_net_return_pct of kept development entries (S02 targets, same execution contract)

evaluation.engine: S03 event engine, backtest mode, hourly events from the first test cutoff to the closing fill

criteria.rule: INCONCLUSIVE if any fold has fewer filtered trades than the minimum; CANDIDATE if total compound improvement > minimum AND winning folds >= minimum AND drawdown within tolerance in every fold; REJECTED if total improvement <= minimum; INCONCLUSIVE otherwise

reproducibility.note: same spec, dataset and code give identical models and report
